note: The OF16 day manifest: the plan's section 2 table as data. Day roles are pre-registered here; ragrl/real.py records this file's sha256 in every test or confirm opening (ledger_usage.jsonl). Exports never enter the repo: tools/sierra_to_ticks.py writes EXPORT_DIR/<date>/ticks.csv and a ticks.json sidecar holding the CSV's sha256, which real.py verifies before a tape is opened.

rth.dst: CDT (UTC-5) before 2026-11-01, CST (UTC-6) from 2026-11-01; US rule: second Sunday of March 02:00 to the first Sunday of November 02:00 local

data.depth_record: <qBBHfII (24 bytes, 64-byte header): Sierra time (us since 1899-12-30 UTC), command 1-7, flags (1 = end of batch), orders, price x100, quantity, reserved
data.scid_record: <q4f4I (40 bytes, 56-byte header): Sierra time, open (sub-trade marker), high = ask, low = bid, close = trade price (prices x100), trades, volume, bid volume (sell aggressor), ask volume (buy aggressor)

episodes.note: ReplayScalpEnv: the tape starts at 08:30 CT (or the first valid book after it); window k is played after a 1050 s feature warm-up on the tape from k x 600 s (the warm-up every OF15 run trained with, env.warmup_seconds; score-real refuses a run whose warm-up, decision step or episode length differ). windows = (buckets - 10500) // 6000 at 100 ms: 37 per full day (234000 buckets), 33 on 2026-11-09 (book from ~09:03 CT: any start before 09:12:30 gives 33), 292 test windows in all. Amended 2026-11-12 before any test opening (was 150 s: 38 per day, ~301); see the plan's section 2 amendment
